item.title: Does It Matter If AI Wrote This?
item.description:
LLMs are so useful that it’s hard not to use them. And yet I hate it when somebody sends me a document that reads like it was written entirely by Claude or by ChatGPT. The signal it sends is that the writer didn’t put any effort into it.

This is not something that’s unique to me. It’s a topic of conversation I find frequently in all the various circles I am connected to. One client’s office has a stance of “no blank sheeting”, and they require all colleagues to do their first draft entirely before asking AI to help with edits. Another organisation I work with suggests that people are allowed to use AI to create things, but they should disclose it. And even extremely AI-savvy and AI-forward authors like Ethan Mollick make a big deal of it.
